EncoreCover-led · sheets, lists, sequences

Tokens

This design keeps the names and the values of tokens.dart and adds what "colour from the music" needs. A+ marks an added token, changed marks a value that was changed, with the reason. Everything on the frames is drawn from these custom properties.

Added by group 2 (sheets, lists and sequences)

--sheet-scrim A+
rgba(0,0,0,.62)
the dim under a sheet, dialog or panel (rgba(14,14,16,.52) in light); the context behind it is inert
--on-art-muted A+
rgba(255,255,255,.80)
second-level text on artwork: lyrics page, story-card captions
--lyric-bg A+
color-mix(--art 78 %, #000)
the lyrics page: the same mix as the mini player, so one colour follows the song from the mini player to the lyrics
--year-bg A+
color-mix(--art 62 %, #000)
a story card of Year in Music; each card takes the colour of its own cover
--year-glow A+
color-mix(--art 55 %, #fff)
decorative discs and rings on a story card, 20 % at the most, never as the only thing under text
--av-1 .. --av-5 (and b) A+
#ffb347 > #ff5f8f, #4ee3c1 > #2b7fff, #ffd166 > #ef476f, #c77dff > #5a189a, #80ed99 > #22577a
five avatar gradients; no initials (a letter in a picture is text in a picture); the name is always beside it

Marks on a song row are the usual ones and nothing else: the green arrow (downloaded), the heart (liked), E (explicit) and, offline, a grey row with the words "Not downloaded". Waiting for the server and cannot play are marks of the scrubber and of the strip (S-31), not of rows. The five story-card colours are the colour of five covers; the card itself is always darker than the cover.

Computed by the script that built this page (WCAG relative luminance, sRGB mixing as in color-mix), over every cover; 4.5 : 1 for text, 3 : 1 for large text, graphics and boundaries. Waiting, broken and offline are also told apart without colour: words, icon and structure (the frames in "Compare states").

Weights 400, 600, 700, 800. Stated exceptions at 200 %: bottom-tab labels grow to 150 % and stop (four labels in 360 px; the icon and the pill carry the rest); the artist name on its picture stops at 150 % and the Welcome headline at 130 %; the shortcut grid on Home becomes one column; the duration column and the yellow tags leave the song rows on C. Everything else wraps. The cover on Now playing is the thing that gives way, and the Welcome and the typed-address panels scroll so every button stays reachable.

Motion

What movesHowUnder "Remove animations"
Equaliser bars on the TV now-playing chip (rows carry only the green title)scaleY of 3 bars, 900 ms loop, only while visible and playingthree still bars (50, 100, 70 %)
Cover wall on WelcometranslateX of two opposite rows, 50 s each way (30-60 s per screen width)still
Logo bars on Welcome and "Looking for your server…"‎scaleY, 1.1 s loop; never on a page that waits long, there it is a still sentencestill
Colour of the page follows the coverbackground colour tween, 450 ms ease-out-cubic (--m-colour)cut at once
Cover grows into the headerHero, 320 ms (--m-emphasized); not drawn (needs two pages)cross-fade, 120 ms
Skeletonopacity 1 to .55, 1.6 s, on the block, not on every rowstill
Catalogue still lookinga 2 px bar sweeps, 1.6 s; the words staystill bar, words stay
QR scan linetranslateY, 2.4 s, alternateline in the middle
Testing the connection, and a song still being fetcheda small ring turns, 1 s; no words about servers on a song rowstatic ring with a gap
TV focusring and scale 1.06, 120 ms (--m-quick)ring only, at once

Everything that loops is transform or opacity only. The wall and the bars are the only continuous animations on a page that plays music; each stops when it is not visible and when the battery saver is on (docs/16 §4). Not measured yet: a mid phone is the test.

Why: Cover-led

The design of sheets, lists and sequences, in six lines.

The ideaThe music is the interface: each page takes its colour from the cover that plays, and the cover is the biggest thing on it. Sheets, lists and sequences keep that: the colour follows the song from the mini player to the lyrics, the Jam and the story cards.‎
Good atFeeling personal at a glance and familiar at once (the screens are the ones everybody knows), and honest states told apart by words, icon and structure, not by hue.‎
Bad at200 % text, sunlight and text-heavy pages (the cover shrinks first); a page with no cover yet falls back to abstract art. At 200 % pages scroll instead of clipping; the TV covers shrink.‎
Flutter costModalBottomSheet and DraggableScrollableSheet for the sheets, ReorderableListView for handles, PageView with a segmented progress bar for Year in Music, PaletteGenerator in an isolate for the colour, FocusTraversalGroup with Shortcuts for the TV.‎
FramesNo blur and no shader animation: the equaliser bars, the skeleton pulse and the small spinner are the only loops, transform and opacity only; to measure on a mid phone.‎
Group 2Sheets, lists and sequences in the same shell: three tabs, the usual row marks only (green arrow, heart, E, "Not downloaded"), one focus per frame, sheets on C, popovers and a right panel on X, side panels on T; Year in Music is the one place where the colour is loud.‎
